authority: Owner-selected mathematical defensibility and implementation correctness; no measured approximation error or empirical flat-world accuracy claim.

physicalModel.ground: black: groundBoundary=null; visual materials do not contribute atmospheric reflection
physicalModel.ozone: disabled; absorption remains zero; future owner selection required
physicalModel.geometry: Horizontally uniform slab over a flat plane, source height strictly above top; finite construction cylinder is computational coverage.
physicalModel.source: Frozen Native15 spectrum and finite isotropic source; pointwise direction and inverse-square scaling outside radius clamp; stored J1 retains 2048 held source-strength bands.
physicalModel.symmetry: Positions use Euclidean source distance and altitude; outgoing direction retains angular dependence. Horizontal rigid transforms require matching source-centered domain and directional frames; height and physical-property changes rebuild.
physicalModel.boundaryAdmission: Omit a band only when outer radius < height-top. Retain tangent/support bands and vacuum propagation. Nonintersecting bands receive neither scattering allocation nor construction work.
physicalModel.outsideCoverage: Reject unsupported queries or request a replacement build; no silent clamping or outside-vacuum substitution.
physicalModel.support: Compact per-altitude rows retain axis and outer-cylinder support; radius-excess arithmetic and positive Euclidean-radius stencils reconstruct across rows/bands.
physicalModel.orders: Pure J1..J4, transported L1..L3 and Jthrough4=sum(J1..J4); consumers use cumulative density, recurrence uses the compatible preceding pure order. No all-orders claim.

requiredClaims: Trace preserved coefficients, units, phase, attenuation and pure-order equations to the abstraction inventory.
Defend normalized reconstruction and optical-column integration with stated assumptions, limits and ordinary analytic/implementation correctness checks.
Complete admitted support, compact address round trips, finite nonnegative fields, all 15 channels and complete rays; identify each physical quantity.
Compact/unculled comparison uses identical occupied nodes and equations; record omitted work and actual logical allocations separately from device telemetry.
CPU/GPU and fresh/reused parity use retained quantity limits and identical candidate policy; no claim of independent physical accuracy.
Frozen five-state visual cadence and exact-state receiver lighting; preserve Flat90 holdout and mutation rule.
Coherent publication, cancellation, failure, supersession and disposal; retained temporal, coverage, allocation and performance gates.
Mapped source review and local type check remain implementation-completion requirements.
legacyDisposition: Prior passes, failures and inconclusive results remain under their original identities. Deferred accuracy thresholds are retained as history, never represented as passed current gates.
consumerRule: New scoring must name the frozen current contract/gate identity. Old hard-coded gate/reference runners do not automatically adopt this policy and must be adapted and reviewed before claiming a current result.

execution.languages: JavaScript; Python only for suitable support; no compiled helper or executable
execution.scope: P3-A only; no candidate capture, video, production change or broad accuracy campaign
